reclamation: only each newly owned obj after all phase runtimes and durable closed file-hash receipts; never delete old failed build or failed current phase
terminal_first_failure: compile error/time/output cap, positive mismatch, negative missing exactSIGABRT marker, hash/ownership closure/reclaim error or OOM stops all later jobs; preserve failure and current obj
producer_adapter: separate finite model only; no actual producer cancellation implementation
GO_template_conversion: Parent must independently review, set status to requested_status, remove requested_status, and commit the otherwise exact template. Pending template alone is rejected.
superseded_plan: plan_attempt1_superseded is historical preparation; use plan_r2 only.
